solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Separate identity given in sleazy bar

indicators.note: something given in to another is placed inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a dive is a disreputable drinking place
ID is the usual short form of identity

explanation.surface: Someone keeps their identity apart while drinking in a seedy bar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Separate' could be an adjective, but the definition works as a verb; 'given in' signals one piece inside another.
explanation.definitionFit: To divide things is to split them apart, a straight verb synonym.

clue.text: Mother a bit wet, not all there

indicators.note: a word that is not all there has lost a piece, here its final letter

parts.note: damp means slightly wet

explanation.surface: A mother who is a little soppy and somewhat dim.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not all there' drops the last letter of DAMP.
explanation.definitionFit: A dam is the mother of an animal, especially of horses or livestock.

clue.text: Contents of mini-vat could supply health supplement

indicators.note: the contents of the word are what gets worked on, its letters taken out to be used afresh
the letters could supply something new when rearranged into another order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A small vat's contents might provide something good for your health.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Contents of' and 'could supply' together say the letters of MINIVAT are rearranged; it is not a hidden word.
explanation.definitionFit: Vitamins are commonly taken as pills to supplement the diet and support wellbeing.

clue.text: Rapid escape, an extraordinary vanishing act

indicators.note: something out of the ordinary is not in its usual form, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A magician's sudden getaway makes for a remarkable trick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extraordinary' signals rearranging the letters of RAPID ESCAPE AN.
explanation.definitionFit: A disappearance is the act of going out of sight, which a vanishing act performs.

clue.text: Carefulness with which engineer approaches old Chaldean city

indicators.note: one piece approaches another by coming right up beside it, so the pieces sit together in order

parts.note: to rig something is to engineer or contrive it
Ur was the ancient city of the Chaldees in Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: An engineer carefully nears the ruins of an ancient Mesopotamian city.
explanation.walkthrough: RIG and O come up to UR, the biblical Ur of the Chaldees.
explanation.definitionFit: Rigour means strict thoroughness and precision, so carefulness is a close synonym.

clue.text: Popular copper entertains them periodically, beyond a doubt

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular

indicators.note: a host entertains guests by taking them in, so one piece holds another

parts.note: copper is slang for a police officer, a constable

indicators.note: periodically means at regular intervals, so every other letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A well-liked police officer undeniably plays host to some visitors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'periodically' takes the odd letters of 'them'; 'entertains' sets that pair inside the copper, early in the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Incontestable means impossible to dispute, so certain without question.

clue.text: Norma maybe is not entirely cooperative

indicators.note: only part of the word is used, so the answer lies inside its letters

explanation.surface: A woman called Norma is somewhat less than helpful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Norma' looks like a person, but it is Bellini's opera; 'maybe' marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Norma is a well-known bel canto work by Bellini, an example of the stage form.

clue.text: One badly attired may need to be compensated

definitions.text: One badly attired may need to be
definitions.meaning: someone poorly clothed may need to be dressed again
put right or made amends for

explanation.walkthrough: The first reading splits the word as RE-DRESSED, clothed afresh.
explanation.definitionFit: To redress a wrong is to remedy it, as by paying compensation.

clue.text: Group in the morning coming back chums

indicators.note: something coming back travels the opposite way, so the letters read backwards

parts.note: a set is a group of things or people
AM stands for ante meridiem, before noon

explanation.surface: Friends return as a group from a morning outing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming back' turns SETAM round.
explanation.definitionFit: Mates is informal British usage for friends, just as chums is.

clue.text: Editor about to get set of principles laid down

indicators.note: about can mean turned round, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a creed is a system of beliefs or principles

explanation.surface: An editor is about to receive a code of beliefs that has been set out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' here means turned round rather than concerning, so the editor's letters are reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something decreed has been ordered officially, that is laid down as a rule.

clue.text: Devon flower in spring

definitions.meaning: a flower is a thing that flows, a river; the ... flows through Devon, a county in south-west England

explanation.surface: A Devon bloom appearing in springtime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' is crossword shorthand for a river, something that flows.
explanation.definitionFit: The River Dart runs across Devon, and to dart is to leap or dash.

clue.text: Meat in picnic basket half wasted

indicators.note: with half of the word wasted only the first half is left

parts.note: a hamper is a wicker basket for picnic food

explanation.surface: Half the meat in the picnic basket has gone to waste.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half wasted' keeps HAM, the first half of HAMPER.
explanation.definitionFit: Ham is cured pork, a common type of meat.

clue.text: Historian reveals bad king to us in a different way

parts.note: Herod, king of Judea, ordered the massacre of the innocents

indicators.note: putting the letters in a different way means rearranging them

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A historian shows us a wicked monarch from a new angle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a different way' signals rearranging 'to us' after the Judean king.
explanation.definitionFit: Herodotus was the ancient Greek writer called the father of history.

clue.text: Dad gets torn apart with time — condition of having children

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
rent is an old past participle of rend, to tear
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: A father is upset about time spent raising the kids.
explanation.definitionFit: Parentage can mean the state of being a parent, that is having offspring.

clue.text: Shoot messenger?

definitions.meaning: a plant shoot that grows along the ground and roots
a ... carries messages, as in a battlefield or office ...

explanation.walkthrough: 'Shoot' tempts as a verb meaning fire at; it is the noun from gardening.
explanation.definitionFit: Strawberries spread by runners, and a runner is someone sent with messages.

clue.text: Mathematical concepts appearing in problem: massive

indicators.note: the answer appears within the letters of the following words

explanation.surface: Mathematical ideas crop up in a huge problem.
explanation.definitionFit: A lemma is a minor proposition proved to help establish a theorem.

clue.text: State of an atom, spinning around neutron initially

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go around the other piece, enclosing it
letters spinning about are shuffled into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so the first letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Describing the condition of an atom whirling about a neutron.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spinning' rearranges AN ATOM into MOTANA; 'around' puts it round N from 'neutron initially', after MO.
explanation.definitionFit: Montana is one of the fifty United States, in the north-west.

clue.text: Put up with something hairy for the most part

indicators.note: most of the word is kept, with only its final letter lost

parts.note: a beard is a growth of facial hair

explanation.surface: Mostly tolerating something shaggy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for the most part' drops the last letter of BEARD.
explanation.definitionFit: To bear something is to tolerate or endure it.

clue.text: Prohibition has detective briefly restraining pub workers

indicators.note: to restrain is to hold in, so one piece holds the other inside it

parts.note: DET is a short form of detective
barmen serve drinks in a pub

explanation.surface: A ban is in force as a police officer holds back the bar staff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'restraining' means holding in, so the pub workers sit inside the shortened detective.
explanation.definitionFit: Debarment is the act of excluding or barring, so a prohibition.

clue.text: Female going to match — second-rate journey?

parts.note: B is the grade after A, so second class
a ride is a trip or journey

explanation.surface: A woman heading to a game on a poor-quality trip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'match' looks like a sports fixture but means a marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: A bride is a woman about to be wed, joined in a marriage match.

clue.text: Refusal by daughter to show sign of agreement?

parts.note: no is a refusal
D is the abbreviation for daughter in family trees

explanation.surface: A daughter's refusal oddly shows she agrees.
explanation.definitionFit: A nod of the head is a gesture of assent.

clue.text: Pub submerged in the river could be more watery

indicators.note: something submerged in another is completely inside it

parts.note: taken as written
an inn is a pub
R is the abbreviation for river on maps

explanation.surface: A flooded riverside pub may find its beer more diluted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'submerged in' puts the pub inside 'the' plus the river's abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Thinner soup or paint is runnier, with more liquid to it.

clue.text: Attack bishop, after all the rest

parts.note: B is the chess notation abbreviation for bishop
last means coming after all others

explanation.surface: Someone finally lays into a bishop once everyone else has.
explanation.definitionFit: To blast someone is to criticise them fiercely, or strike with explosives.

clue.text: Deserter heading north is a sailor

indicators.note: in a down clue a word heading north is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a rat is someone who deserts, like rats leaving a sinking ship

explanation.surface: A runaway going north turns out to be a seaman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading north' reads RAT upward in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Tar is an old informal word for a seaman, from tarpaulin.

clue.text: Realise that you have to stop and get very cross

definitions.text: Realise that you have to stop
definitions.meaning: to see a red signal or light is to notice you must halt

explanation.walkthrough: The first reading is literal: seeing a red traffic light.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeing red is an idiom for flaring into rage, and red lights mean halt.

clue.text: Fix material next to display

parts.note: rep is a ribbed woven fabric used for upholstery
to air views is to display them

explanation.surface: Mend the cloth beside the exhibit.
explanation.definitionFit: To repair something is to mend it, a plain synonym of fix.
